text: The Aldermoor hoard now sits in the Lathe Street Gallery, according to curator Hester Vale, who said Friday that the transfer was completed after a quiet handover earlier this week. I saw the sealed crates being carried into the gallery’s rear conservation room just after 9 a.m., and staff confirmed the inventory included 47 bronze objects, 12 silver coins and the chipped river-jade pendant that helped identify the find. Vale told me the gallery will keep the collection in climate storage until a public display opens on 3 December. Outside, two local historians watched the unloading and said they were relieved the hoard had stayed in town instead of going to a regional archive.
